page.overview:
Who is Brooklynn's father?

Brooklynn's father is a very minor character in the Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous series. At some point, Brooklynn and her parents moved to London. They taught their daughter how to fix radios and cars and other things like boats. At the end of season 5 Brooklynn is happily reunited with her father.
